title: Public Health Laboratory Systems Strengthening
description: End-to-end support for building or strengthening national and institutional laboratory systems — from operations design to standard operating procedures — so laboratories function reliably under real-world conditions.

title: Biorepository & Biobank Design and Management
description: Design and operational management of biorepositories and biobanks, including specimen tracking, cold-chain integrity, and safe international shipment — built to the standards research sponsors and regulators require.

title: Disease Surveillance Systems
description: Laboratory-based surveillance system design and technical oversight for TB, HIV, and outbreak-prone diseases including Ebola and SARS-CoV-2, supporting reliable case detection and reporting.

title: Laboratory Quality Systems & Accreditation Support
description: Hands-on support to help laboratories meet international quality standards — including ISO 15189, GCLP, and SLMTA frameworks — through documentation, CAPA processes, and staff training toward formal accreditation.

title: Biosafety & Biosecurity Risk Assessments
description: Practical risk assessments and improvement planning for laboratory biosafety and biosecurity, protecting staff, samples, and the surrounding community.

title: Training & Capacity Building for Laboratory Teams
description: Structured training programs that build lasting, in-house laboratory capability — so quality and compliance don't depend on outside help indefinitely.

title: Laboratory Data Systems & Dashboard Design
description: Redesign of laboratory data capture and reporting systems to close accuracy gaps and give decision-makers dashboards they can actually trust.

title: Technical Assistance to Ministries of Health, WHO-Aligned Partners, and Clinical Trial Sponsors
description: Direct, hands-on technical assistance for governments, global health partners, and clinical trial sponsors navigating complex laboratory system challenges.
